resolutions.researcher_notes: current_ref (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn t2198308.shtml, the DRC core-approval notice for '合山天然气支线管道工程' / Heshan branch) fails url_verifier with ConnectTimeout -- confirmed geo-blocked, consistent with the brief. Checked web.archive.org Wayback Availability API for this exact URL: archived_snapshots={} (no snapshot exists). The prior deep-sweep audit (rows/P7679.json) also surfaced two other Heshan-specific govt filings -- dnr.gxzf.gov.cn t16421841 (land-use pre-review, 2019-07-24) and fgw.gxzf.gov.cn t10409864 (the same core-approval, 2019-09-27) -- both re-checked here: both ConnectTimeout/ReadTimeout via url_verifier, and both also have NO Wayback snapshot (checked directly via the Availability API). Cross-checked via sogou.com search: the top result for this project's DRC approval notice resolves (via sogou's own redirect) to the IDENTICAL blocked URL t2198308.shtml -- i.e. no alternate mirror host exists for this document. A comment-listing page at m.in-en.com/comment/index-htm-mid-26-itemid-3195362.html titles the same project '关于广西天然气支线管网项目合山天然气支线管道工程核准的批复评论列表' (confirming the project name/existence via a non-gxzf.gov.cn host) but is a bare comment list with no technical content, and it fails url_verifier with HTTP 403 (bot-gated), so it cannot be cited. The full in-en.com article is paywalled ('如果您是收费会员，请登录后查看详情' -- members-only). WebSearch tool budget was exhausted mid-session (200/200); fell back to raw curl/urllib against bing.com/sogou.com/baidu.com HTML search endpoints, which eventually rate-limited to empty results. No independently reachable, url_verifier-passing source names this specific branch with a status/approval statement, so I'm leaving this UNRESOLVED rather than citing a non-specific or unreachable page. (Separately, the audit's status_reviews leg already flagged the recorded 'proposed' status itself as stale -> presumed shelved given 7y dormancy; that's a different workflow, not addressed here.)

Same dead-link/no-mirror situation as Status: the only documents that name this specific segment (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn t2198308/t10409864, dnr.gxzf.gov.cn t16421841 -- all titled around '天然气支线管道' i.e. natural-gas branch pipeline, which would directly support Fuel=Gas) are geo-blocked with no Wayback snapshot. Sibling-branch documents that ARE reachable (gigeps.com Qinbei-branch tender, yanshougs.com Hechi-Nandan-branch completion filing -- both verified live, both under the same parent '广西天然气支线管网' natural-gas program) confirm the PARENT network is gas, but neither names the Heshan branch itself, so per the no-orphan/must-name-this-segment standard already applied to this row (see Operator resolution below and the prior audit) I am not pairing them as refs for this specific row. WebSearch budget exhausted; fallback engine scraping (bing/sogou/baidu via curl) found no additional Heshan-specific reachable source. UNRESOLVED.

No Heshan-specific reachable document exists to classify transmission vs. distribution (same blocked/no-mirror situation as above). Circumstantially, sibling branches of the identical parent project that ARE reachable and verified live run at 4.0 MPa design pressure (gigeps.com Qinbei branch: 4.0 MPa/273.1mm; yanshougs.com Hechi-Nandan branch: 4.0 MPa/DN323.9mm/15.28km) -- a pressure class consistent with transmission-grade trunk/branch pipe in China (distribution networks typically run well below 1.6 MPa) -- which is at least consistent with GEM's recorded PipelineType=transmission and matches this row's own recorded Pressure=4.00 MPa. But neither document names the Heshan branch, so this is context, not a citable source for this row. Leaving UNRESOLVED rather than pairing a ref that doesn't name this pipeline.

No reachable document confirms the Xingbin (兴宾)->Heshan (合山) routing specifically -- the two docs that would (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn t10409864, dnr.gxzf.gov.cn t16421841, both titled around the Heshan branch project) are geo-blocked with no Wayback snapshot. The prior deep-sweep audit found the strongest evidence in this whole row here: the fgw.gxzf.gov.cn t10409864 core-approval's docx attachment (W020200317745138153919.docx, dated 2019-09-27, found via search-engine cached snippet) states '本项目总投资12802万元' -- total investment 128.02 million yuan -- an EXACT match to GEM's recorded SegmentCost=128,020,000 RMB. I re-attempted to independently re-verify this live: fgw.gxzf.gov.cn ConnectTimeout via url_verifier (geo-blocked), and web.archive.org's Availability API returns archived_snapshots={} for that exact URL -- no snapshot exists to cite instead. A sogou.com search for the approval notice resolved via its own redirect to the identical blocked URL, confirming there is no alternate mirror. I could not find the docx file itself, or any other page displaying this cost figure, at any reachable host. Despite the figure being an exact match (strong circumstantial confidence the value is correctly sourced), I cannot produce a url_verifier-passing citation, so per the 'never fabricate a URL / every url must pass the verifier' rule this stays UNRESOLVED rather than re-citing the dead link or an unverifiable snippet.
